title: Mistral's open-weight deadline and a price cliff
summary: Mistral Large 4 is in preview and its open weights are due within days, while Ecosia's switch to Chinese open models tests the sovereignty pitch. Also: Gemini 4 Argon's December price doubling, Haiku 5.5's token-length price boundary, the December second AI Act marking date, and Google's Universal Cart going live.
